//noinspection unused
// CHECKSTYLE:OFF
// @formatter:off
// spotless:off
class Directives {
    String label = "x"; //$NON-NLS-1$
    int count; // NOSONAR
    int other; // NOPMD
    void run(int kind) {
        switch (kind) {
            case 1:
                count++;
                // fall through
            default:
                other++;
        }
    }
}
